title: Shoe Dog: A Memoir by the Creator of NIKE
author: Phil Knight
summary: Phil Knight tells how he started selling Japanese running shoes out of his car in the 1960s and built Nike. He covers cash crises, lawsuits and the oddball team that helped him do it.
readIf: you like candid founder stories full of risk, debt and loyalty.
skipIf: you want practical business lessons rather than a personal narrative.
